message.jojosmod.star.awakened: First Star Platinum awakening: +%s willpower. %s: summon · %s: precise strike · %s: barrage · %s: toggle guard.
message.jojosmod.star.required: Summon Star Platinum to use this action.
message.jojosmod.star.busy: Finish your current action before starting another.
message.jojosmod.star.cooldown: This action will be ready in %s s.
message.jojosmod.star.guard: Star Platinum · Frontal guard (up to 2 s)
message.jojosmod.star.finger_locked: Star Finger requires %s willpower. Train your precise strike, barrage and guard against different hostile enemies.
message.jojosmod.mastery.star_finger_unl: Star Finger unlocked! Press %s with Star Platinum summoned.
command.jojosmod.stand.star_mastery_hint: Awaken Star Platinum to begin its mastery challenges.
message.jojosmod.disc.already_has_stand: You already have a Stand. The disc was not consumed.

message.jojosmod.disc.insufficient_willp: You need %s willpower to equip this disc. Your willpower is %s.
message.jojosmod.storage.instructions: I can store your Stand. Bring a single empty Stand Disc and crouch while interacting with me.
message.jojosmod.storage.confirm: Storing your Stand removes it from your character and preserves it in this disc. Crouch and interact again to do so.
message.jojosmod.storage.out_of_reach: Move within 3 blocks of the keeper with no obstacles between you.
message.jojosmod.storage.no_stand: You have no Stand to store. Your empty disc was kept.
message.jojosmod.storage.unknown_stand: Your Stand is unavailable in this version. Your assignment and empty disc were kept.
message.jojosmod.storage.stored: %s was stored in the disc. You no longer have an assigned Stand.
message.jojosmod.already_has_stand: You already have a Stand. The arrow was not consumed.
message.jojosmod.stand_obtained: You obtained %s! Press %s to summon it.
command.jojosmod.training_assigned: Training Stand assigned. Press %s to summon it.
message.jojosmod.star.intercept_locked: Interception requires %s willpower. Complete all three Star Platinum challenges.
message.jojosmod.mastery.intercept_unloc: Precise interception unlocked! Press %s against an incoming frontal arrow.
message.jojosmod.star.leap_ground: Stand on solid ground with headroom to leap with your Stand.
message.jojosmod.star.leap_locked: Stand leap requires %s willpower. Complete one Star Platinum challenge.
message.jojosmod.mastery.leap_unlocked: Stand leap unlocked! Press %s on the ground to launch forward.
message.jojosmod.mastery.finger_bonus: Star Finger: cooldown reduced from 6 to 5 s starting with the next activation.
message.jojosmod.mastery.intercept_bonus: Interception: cooldown reduced from 3 to 2.5 s starting with the next activation.
command.jojosmod.stand.finger_training: Ranged Star Finger: deal health damage to 3 different hostile enemies with a contact more than 3 blocks away. Reward: +1 willpower and a 5 s cooldown.
command.jojosmod.stand.intercept_trainin: Interception: catch arrows from 3 different hostile enemies. Reward: +1 willpower and a 2.5 s cooldown. Player and dispenser arrows give no progress.
command.jojosmod.stand.star_finger_maste: Star Finger mastered — press %s; 5 s cooldown.
message.jojosmod.hierophant.awakened: First Hierophant Green awakening: +%s willpower. %s: summon; %s: Emerald Splash. Check /stand progress.
message.jojosmod.hierophant.mastered: Emerald Splash mastered: +%s willpower (total: %s). Four-second cooldown from the next activation.
command.jojosmod.hierophant.training: Emerald Splash: %s/%s different hostiles. Deal health damage in survival; mastery gives +1 willpower and reduces cooldown from 5 to 4 s.
command.jojosmod.hierophant.splash: Press %s with Hierophant Green summoned: 9 emeralds, 14-block range, 5 s cooldown. Walls stop the projectiles.
command.jojosmod.hierophant.mastered: Press %s: Emerald Splash mastered, 4 s cooldown. Walls and PvP/team rules still apply.
death.attack.emerald_splash.item: %1$s was hit by %2$s's Emerald Splash using %3$s
message.jojosmod.crusader.awakened: %s awakened! Willpower increased. R: summon, Z: attack, X: secondary, C: utility. See /stand progress.
message.jojosmod.crusader.mastered: Mastery %s/%s: +%s willpower and 20%% faster primary cooldown.
message.jojosmod.crusader.anchor: Aim at a solid block between 2 and 12 blocks away.
message.jojosmod.time.locked: Summon The World with willpower 4, or Star Platinum with willpower 6, to stop time.
hud.jojosmod.time: %s · Time stop · requires willpower %s · 30 s cooldown
hud.jojosmod.silver_chariot.utility: %s · Release armor · 5 s, faster thrusts, +25%% damage taken
hud.jojosmod.magicians_red.secondary: %s · Red Bind · 2 s restraint, 6 s cooldown
hud.jojosmod.hermit_purple.secondary: %s · Vine grapple · solid anchor within 12 blocks
hud.jojosmod.hermit_purple.utility: %s · Spirit divination · nearest hostile within 16 blocks
hud.jojosmod.the_fool.primary: %s · Sand blast · three pulses, 2.5 s cooldown
message.jojosmod.hierophant.barrier: Emerald barrier placed: 10 s, stay within 16 blocks. C cancels it.
message.jojosmod.advanced.silver_chariot: Rapier launched — recover it before striking again.
message.jojosmod.advanced.magicians_red: Life detector — nearby hostile life revealed.
message.jojosmod.advanced.the_fool: Sand dome — protects you and teammates within 3 blocks.
message.jojosmod.journey.welcome: Stardust journey: find a desert temple. Use /stand journey for your next objective.
message.jojosmod.journey.keeper_near: A disc keeper awaits near this temple: %s, %s, %s.
message.jojosmod.journey.challenge_locke: Master one challenge with your current Stardust Stand and reach willpower 4. Sneak-interact with empty hands to challenge DIO.
message.jojosmod.journey.night: DIO only accepts the challenge at night (13000–23000).
message.jojosmod.journey.peaceful: The encounter requires Easy, Normal or Hard difficulty.
message.jojosmod.journey.retry: This temple is resting. Retry after one minute from the previous challenge.
message.jojosmod.journey.challenge: DIO approaches! Patterns are announced; dodge knives and watch the time-stop windup. Leave 48 blocks to withdraw.
message.jojosmod.journey.victory: DIO defeated together: +2 willpower, longer movement in foreign stopped time, and one personal The World core.
message.jojosmod.journey.claim_full: Your The World core is reserved. Free a slot and use /stand claim, or return to a keeper.
message.jojosmod.journey.claimed: The World core received. Craft it with an empty disc to preserve your current Stand.
message.jojosmod.journey.next_arrow: 1. Find a Stardust Arrow in desert temple chests (20% per chest). Right-click the air to awaken one of six Crusaders.
message.jojosmod.journey.next_mastery: 2. Learn your Stand: /stand progress. Complete a mastery challenge against three distinct hostiles.
message.jojosmod.journey.next_keeper: 3. Visit a desert temple to find its disc keeper. Interact to learn the service and gain +1 willpower once.
message.jojosmod.journey.next_dio: 4. Prepare with friends. At night, sneak-interact with the temple keeper without a blank disc to challenge DIO. Contributors earn their own victory.
message.jojosmod.journey.next_claim: 5. Your The World core is reserved: free an inventory slot and use /stand claim.
message.jojosmod.journey.next_complete: Journey complete. Store your Stand at the keeper with a blank disc and sneak confirmation; craft and equip The World’s disc. Master its own kit.
message.jojosmod.dio.telegraph.strike: DIO winds up a heavy strike — step out of reach!
message.jojosmod.dio.telegraph.knives: DIO readies knives — move sideways or find cover!
advancement.jojosmod.journey.root.descri: Find a Stand Arrow in an ancient desert temple.
advancement.jojosmod.journey.awaken.desc: Awaken a Stardust Stand and learn its controls.
advancement.jojosmod.journey.mastery.des: Complete one personal Stand mastery challenge.
advancement.jojosmod.journey.meet_keeper: Meet the disc keeper at a desert temple.
Contribute to defeating DIO; the last hit is not required.
message.jojosmod.journey.mastery_core: %s mastery core received: one reward per Stand and player.
message.jojosmod.journey.mastery_full: Your mastery core is reserved. Free a slot and use /stand claim.
message.jojosmod.journey.next_legacy: Your Stand belongs to the earlier catalogue. Preserve it in a disc at a temple keeper with a blank disc, then use a Stardust Arrow. Existing data is never replaced automatically.
